scope: Read-only input and recorded timing comparison; no fitting or browser rerun.

comparisons.method: nearest pixel-centre sampling in normalized crop coordinates
nearest pixel-centre sampling in normalized crop coordinates

limitations: Different-resolution masks are compared by nearest pixel-centre sampling; this comparison includes resampling differences.
Recorded timings have different targets, configurations and execution contexts and are not a controlled performance comparison.
No causal runtime contribution has been assigned to target resolution, search budget or browser execution.
finding: The automatic browser crop equals the frozen benchmark quad exactly. Both nearest-pixel resampling comparisons have zero mismatches: the 400px browser mask is an enlargement of the 337px native target with no additional image detail. The two solvers nevertheless return different counts; targets, budget, settings and runtime must be isolated before assigning causality.
